title: 32 km inversion, 5 L-BFGS-B iterations on the new defaults (no solver or optimizer knob set), against the SEP1 study's exp arm
mesh: antarctica_320000_32000_buffered0 (Quartz's .msh, sha256 fd66fc42; 6,282 vertices, 9,055 cells), DG0 geometry, vertex raster sampling
initial_state: cold start: u = 0.1 u_obs, theta = phi = 0, the n,m 1 to 3 ramp under full_mumps, then the direct forward (ISMIP7_DIRECT_FORWARD default)
forcing: MEaSUREs v2 450 m (sha256 268be94e) and BedMachine v4.1 (sha256 6bd08dbb), byte-identical to Quartz's antarctica/data; ISMIP7_FLUIDITY_PRIOR=legacy; the exp friction control (ISMIP7_FRICTION_CONTROL=exp); SEP1 sub-element friction, version 2 (the default), with the exact front push; bi-Laplacian prior (sigma_alpha 1 log unit, auto; C_ref auto; sigma 0.3 on phi; rho 7.5 km); ISMIP7_INVERSION_LINEAR_SOLVER, ISMIP7_GRAD_PRECOND and ISMIP7_DIAGNOSTIC_LINEAR_SOLVER unset (the timing record names scpc_gamg, none and full_mumps); no dH/dt term; log-speed weight 0; scipy L-BFGS-B in plain coordinates
site: IU workstation (Mac, 16 cores, 128 GB), data under /Volumes/LaCie/Data/antarctica_general/ismip7_obs
resources: 4 ranks, alone on the machine (load average 2.0 at the start, 6.0 at the end); peak 2.9 GB a rank
code: a101bdd (PR 155, the default change), a git archive run from the session scratch; icepack_tools e7b923e
cost: about 3 min wall; 7.11 s an evaluation (median after the first) and 1.45 s before each the per-evaluation checkpoint
audit: 5 iterations, 7 evaluations, objective 3.861500e4 to 1.341402e4; every evaluation within 1.6e-10 of test-32km-inversion-sep1-opt-exp-none (full_mumps, the same optimizer); every direct forward converged, no lost trial; published residual 1.3e-3
notes: checks that the defaults of a101bdd select scpc_gamg for the taped solves, keep the full_mumps startup ramp and run L-BFGS-B without a metric, end to end
